News
Pawnee County Coop is looking for 1–2 active members who are interested in becoming an Associate Board Member . This is an opportunity to become more involved with your cooperative, gain experience with the board, and help provide insight and perspective as we look toward the future of Pawnee County Coop.
Requirements:
Must be an active member of Pawnee County Coop
Be interested in learning more about cooperative leadership and board service
Be willing to participate and contribute to board discussions and activities
If you are interested or would like to learn more, please reach out to Shane Eck, General Manager , at 620-285-2161 .
2026 Corn Discounts Schedule
PCCA Update : We are excited to share that we have recently installed a new wheat seed cleaner, providing our patrons with improved cleaning capacity ahead of future planting seasons. The upgraded equipment does a great job of removing unwanted material, helping ensure our growers receive clean, high-quality seed. In addition, we expect the new cleaner to double our cleaning capacity. This added capacity will mean shorter wait times, quicker turnaround, and the ability to handle larger volumes. This investment reflects Pawnee County Co-op’s ongoing commitment to supporting local agriculture and providing the services our patrons need to remain productive and profitable. We would love the opportunity to clean your seed wheat this upcoming season.
Agronomy News
Please visit with us today to plan your fertilizer program for 2026 and 2027 crops. You may reach our team at the following numbers:
Matt Crotinger (Agronomy Manager, Larned): 620-910-7744
Rick Wilson (Elevator Manager, Dartmouth): 620-564-2773
Corey Torrez (Sales Agronomist): 620-910-7025
Grain News and Policies
Cash Bids and Forward Contracting
Cash bids are now available via e-trade. Please note that while bids are updated during both day and night trading sessions, they remain delayed. We are also offering forward contract pricing for new crop 2026–2027. For specific details, contact the Larned Office at 620-285-2161 .
Moisture Limits and Discounts
PCCA will accept Milo up to 16% moisture and Corn up to 19% moisture. Standard discount schedules will apply to these deliveries.
Trading Hours and Verification
All grain bids are subject to verification with the Grain Department. Cash bids are delayed by 10 minutes. Due to volatility in grain futures, we will only purchase grain between 8:30 AM and 1:15 PM on business days.
